outcome: INVESTIGATION_WITNESSED — Optical refinement can produce apparent travel in a paused Reef. The visitor’s microscope-zoom requirement remains OPEN.

observations.scope: Full public generation, paused Reef, Chromium WebGL2 / SwiftShader. Crawlercam entered through the visitor interface. The build’s no-Worker fallback loaded the full feed.
observations.result: At 2026-09-14 10:21 UTC, 104 sessions stayed active. The overview rendered 0 individual bodies and 4 colonies. After following Prober 5E79 and letting the camera settle, it rendered 13 bodies and 7 colonies. The Prober’s world center was identical at first camera contact and after settling.

observations.scope: Owner simulation, 12 camera scale changes with replay paused across four playheads at 10%, 30%, 60% and 85%.
observations.result: Baseline produced 1,636 coarse transits triggered by camera changes. A candidate tied travel to the source walk and placed aggregates at their members’ weighted centroids. The same tests produced 0 camera-triggered transits. In two playing runs of 240 frames each the source trajectories matched the baseline.
observations.limit: A correct weighted centroid constrains the average position. Individual ink kernels can still shift inside the aggregate.

observations.scope: Actual ink shader, isolated candidate using each member’s body-scale support.
observations.result: At distant zoom the proxy lost much of the aggregate’s visible density. Preserving members’ positions alone did not preserve the appearance of the distant drop.

observations.scope: One frozen real Prober, 5E79, at 2026-10-06 04:38 UTC. Separate test from the September Crawlercam observation.
observations.result: The coarse body used only its center while the detailed body exposed 47 kernels. Reusing the same anatomy across zoom levels removed that support change for this specimen.

observations.scope: Owner simulation, 30% playhead at linear projection scale 4,000. This scene had 406 live sessions and 309 resolved bodies.
observations.result: Rendering full anatomy for every resolved Being increased body splats from 5,830 to 16,910 in this scene. These counts describe emitted splats, not device frame time.

context.continuation: The question is how one drop can retain its distant density and reveal its members at their own sites as the camera approaches, within the measured rendering budget. The separate cold-acquisition intake remains independently addressable.
